snippet.title: Kingdom of Night - Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Kingdom of Night comes to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 5, 2026!

Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X|S preorders begin September 17, with a 10% preorder discount available ahead of launch.

PlayStation 5 players can descend deeper into the night with the exclusive Kingdom of Night — MIDNIGHT EDITION. This special edition includes the complete game and the “NIGHT OF ’97” PSN Avatar Collection, featuring 25 exclusive PSN avatars based on the characters of Kingdom of Night.

A NIGHT WORTH REMEMBERING
Originally released for PC in December 2025, Kingdom of Night earned praise for its atmospheric fusion of 1980s nostalgia and supernatural horror, its handcrafted pixel-art world, open-ended exploration, character customization, and local co-op.

Now, the night comes to consoles.

WHEN HELL COMES TO YOUR HOMETOWN, FIGHT BACK.
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.
When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes—Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer—and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.
Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in two-player local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.
Friday night just became the end of the world.

KEY FEATURES
Welcome to Miami, 1987 — Explore a handcrafted Arizona town consumed by a demonic invasion, from quiet suburban streets and local hangouts to sprawling underground lairs.

Coming-of-Age Meets Cosmic Horror — Experience a story blending teenage drama, 1980s nostalgia, dark fantasy, and supernatural horror as one ordinary night spirals into the apocalypse.

Choose Your Class — Play as a Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer, each offering a distinct approach to combat.

Build Your Own Demon Slayer — Customize your character through expansive skill trees and hunt for powerful weapons, armor, rare loot, and unique equipment.

Take Back the Town Your Way — Explore Miami freely and challenge its terrifying Demon Generals in the order you choose.

Don't Face the Night Alone — Play the full adventure solo or team up with a friend in two-player local co-op.
